subject: a_b_posting_entry_64_not_128_pack_group
body:
A-B-POST-64-01 PostingEntry 64 != 128-bit pack group (NOT a rematch of 074024/072711/082517)

FACT: live R1 31_VERIFICATION_AND_CAUSAL_TESTS.md has no PostingEntry / 2x64 packing check.
Architecture:
  POSTING_ENTRY_WIDTH = 64
  packing two entries per 128-bit group is PACK_GROUP, not a 128-bit entry type
  packing != identity != MIG_APP_W freeze
  Query/Result/Event remain §04 (256/384/192)

When B extends §31 M2 posting tests, check 64-bit entries / optional 2x64 group
without promoting PostingEntry to 128-bit ontology.
§03 ACTION_INTENT precheck and §05.8 pass names remain OPEN (not rematched here).
NOT M2_PASS.
